scope: Bounded complement-mediated aHUS: inherited or acquired complement dysregulation at endothelial surfaces, terminal complement injury and thrombotic microangiopathy. Human cohorts, endothelial assays and animal experiments remain distinct. Excludes STEC-HUS, TTP, secondary TMA, DGKE and cobalamin-related TMA.

paragraphs.text: In 147 aHUS patients, 16 juvenile autoantibody-positive patients had absent or very low CFHR1/CFHR3. IgG from five unrelated aHUS patients inhibited factor H binding to C3b in a functional assay.

These selected findings describe a bounded candidate, whose overall explanation has not been independently checked against current literature. Association does not establish that deletion causes autoantibodies or that deficiency is sufficient for aHUS. Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending. Eculizumab binds C5 and inhibits cleavage into C5a/C5b, preventing terminal MAC generation. Drug targeting and approval do not establish every proposed mechanism or benefit in every phenotype.
